'''Melon sorbet''' is the meal of the [[melon]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and grants {{EffectLink|Fire Resistance}} for 10 minutes, the longest Fire Resistance from food.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/melon_sorbet.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A melon slice, a snowball, sugar and a glass bottle. Picking up a melon slice unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating melon sorbet takes 1.2 seconds, heals {{Hp|4}} and gives Fire Resistance for 10:00. It gives the glass bottle back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_23.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
